articles.title: Analysts see no broader ‘contagion’ from $6.3B Binance hack
articles.description: Binance’s pledge to cover all user losses helped contain the fallout from the $6.3 billion hack, analysts said.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today

articles.title: The $2.85B Binance hackers lost shows why the UK needs stablecoin freeze rules
articles.description: The Binance hack proved stablecoin freezes work. Now the UK should make clear freeze rules a condition of listing coins.

articles.title: Strategy buys 1,036 Bitcoin as BTC holdings climb to 850,364
articles.description: Strategy bought $81.9 million in Bitcoin last week while spending $188.3 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares, according to its latest SEC filing.

articles.title: EU taps industry to set standards for tokenized securities
articles.description: Applications close Nov. 27 for an industry group that aims to draft initial standards for holding and settling tokenized securities by early 2028.

articles.title: Coinbase’s US national trust bank charter takes effect
articles.description: Coinbase plans to expand its institutional crypto custody business under the federal charter and is exploring digital asset payment products.

articles.title: Robinhood opens access to US IPOs for UK retail investors
articles.description: Robinhood’s UK customers can request shares in eligible US initial public offerings at the offer price before the stocks begin trading.

articles.title: BTC price eyes $73K amid Nvidia volatility: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week

articles.title: Binance, Tether and Trump crypto firms face Senate records deadline
articles.description: Sen. Richard Blumenthal asked four crypto firms to start sending records by Nov. 30 and warned of further action if they miss the Jan. 4 deadline.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $1.3B in biggest weekly outflow since late June

articles.title: Zcash devs propose another block time cut days after NU7 upgrade

articles.title: tBTC bridge partially resumes as $120M Aave reserve remains frozen

articles.title: Binance France emails announce closure of its users’ accounts on Dec. 31

articles.title: Bitcoin holders have received eCash — What can you do with it?

articles.title: Bitcoin price dips under $75K as crypto markets miss tech-stock rebound

articles.title: Nigeria sets new crypto licensing rules, bans algorithmic stablecoins
